name: ai-sdlc
description: Vibe coding for developers, on rails: the AI-native SDLC playbook as a Claude Code plugin. Ideas become a committed intent → spec → plan → verified build → independent review → gated ship chain, with opinionated stack profiles (Nuxt/Next on Cloudflare, Nuxt/Next BFF + Go/Postgres, Flutter, Tauri), risk-tiered ceremony, deterministic hooks (plan gate, test lock, secrets, production gate, verify-before-done) and a closed maintenance loop.
